question: How many films are rated PG and are longer than 120 minutes?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM film WHERE rating = 'PG' AND length > 120

question: What is the total payment revenue from customers whose home store is store 2?
gold_sql: SELECT sum(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN customer c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.store_id = 2

question: How many distinct films were rented in December 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT i.film_id) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE r.rental_date >= '2025-12-01' AND r.rental_date < '2026-01-01'

question: For each film category, how many distinct actors have appeared in its films? Show the category name and the number of actors.
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, count(DISTINCT fa.actor_id) FROM category c JOIN film_category fc ON c.category_id = fc.category_id JOIN film_actor fa ON fc.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY c.name

question: What is the median payment amount?
gold_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY amount) FROM payment

question: Which customers made more than 70 rentals? Show first name, last name and the number of rentals.
gold_sql: SELECT c.first_name, c.last_name, count(*) FROM rental r JOIN customer c ON r.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name HAVING count(*) > 70

question: For each film category, which film earned the most payment revenue? Show the category name, the film title and its revenue.
gold_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT c.name AS category, f.title, sum(p.amount) AS revenue, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY c.name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC) AS rn FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id JOIN film_category fc ON f.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id GROUP BY c.name, f.film_id, f.title) SELECT category, title, revenue FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1

question: What percentage of all customers have rented at least one Horror film?
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(DISTINCT r.customer_id) / (SELECT count(*) FROM customer) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_category fc ON i.film_id = fc.film_id JOIN category c ON fc.category_id = c.category_id WHERE c.name = 'Horror'

question: Which day of the week has the most rentals? Show the day name and the number of rentals.
gold_sql: SELECT trim(to_char(rental_date, 'Day')) AS day, count(*) AS rentals FROM rental GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY rentals DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many actors have never appeared in a film rated G?
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM actor a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM film_actor fa JOIN film f ON fa.film_id = f.film_id WHERE fa.actor_id = a.actor_id AND f.rating = 'G')

question: How many big-spending customers do we have?
definition: VIP (not a listed synonym): lifetime total payments greater than 250
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM payment GROUP BY customer_id HAVING sum(amount) > 250) t

question: How many customers have stopped renting from us?
definition: Churned (not a listed synonym): most recent rental more than 180 days before the latest rental date
gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id, max(rental_date) AS last_rental FROM rental GROUP BY customer_id) t WHERE last_rental < (SELECT max(rental_date) FROM rental) - interval '180 days'

question: What proportion of our film catalogue was rented at least once in 2024?
definition: Catalog utilization for 2024, phrased without the term
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(DISTINCT i.film_id) / (SELECT count(*) FROM film) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id WHERE r.rental_date >= '2024-01-01' AND r.rental_date < '2025-01-01'

question: What share of returned rentals came back late?
definition: Late return rate, phrased without the term
gold_sql: SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE r.return_date - r.rental_date > f.rental_duration * interval '1 day') / count(*) FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id WHERE r.return_date IS NOT NULL

question: Which actor is our best performer?
definition: Best performer applied to actors: highest total payment revenue
gold_sql: SELECT a.first_name, a.last_name FROM payment p JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id JOIN actor a ON fa.actor_id = a.actor_id GROUP BY a.actor_id, a.first_name, a.last_name ORDER BY sum(p.amount) DESC LIMIT 1

question: What was our AOV in 2024?
definition: Average order value restricted to 2024 payments
gold_sql: SELECT avg(amount) FROM payment WHERE payment_date >= '2024-01-01' AND payment_date < '2025-01-01'
